 Represented By Adv.-
 Mr. P.R. Singh
 -versus-
 State of Odisha ....

Opp. Party
 Represented By Adv.-
Mr. A. Sethy, Asc
Coram:
THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ADITYA KUMAR MOHAPATRA Order No. ORDER  06.01.2025  02. I.A. No.3020 of 2024  1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.
This I.A. has been filed for modification of order dated 18.12.2024.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that vide order dated 18.12.2024, the petitioner was directed to surrender before the Court below and be released on bail, however, the same was subject to verification of criminal antecedent of the Petitioner.
He further submitted that at the time of verification, it was detected that the petitioner has an antecedent under Section 498A of the IPC.

4. In such view of the matter, the order dated 18.12.2024 is modified to the extent that the learned Court below shall verify the antecedent of the petitioner and in the event it is found that the petitioner has more than one antecedent, the order dated 18.12.2024 shall not be given effect to.

Four weeks' further time from today is extended for the petitioner to surrender before the learned court below, vide order dated 18.12.2024 passed in ABLAPL No.14348 of 2024, but subject to depositing cost of Rs.1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand) in the Advocates' Welfare Fund of Orissa Saroj @ Saroja Kumar Samal vs State Of Odisha .... entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: High Court Bar Association within fifteen days and furnishing money receipt thereof in proof of deposit.
5. It is made clear that, if the cost is not deposited within the stipulated time, the time extended for the petitioner to surrender shall stand revoked automatically.
6. With this modification, the I.A. stands disposed of.

Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
(Aditya Kumar Mohapatra) Judge Amit Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Saroj @ Saroja Kumar Samal vs State Of Odisha .... Opp.
